subject: release-tooling/idempotent-recovery
statement: A recovery publisher must recognize the exact interrupted partial-application state and continue idempotently from it. Do not require a manual rollback when already-applied changes are valid and can be positively identified.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Dogfood Agent DevTools by converting proven R6/R6.1 release and recovery failure lessons into durable project knowledge.
